from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal

import tempfile
import time

ROOT = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='startup-748-ab-'))
Path('/tmp/startup-748-ab-latest.txt').write_text(str(ROOT))
SOURCES = {
    'baseline': Path('/tmp/responsiveness-737-final-binary'),
    'compact': Path('/tmp/listing-748-candidate-binary'),
}
assert 'Finished `release`' in Path('/tmp/listing-748-native.log').read_text()
assert SOURCES['compact'].stat().st_mtime >= Path('/tmp/listing-748-frontend.log').stat().st_mtime
BINARIES = {}
for variant, source in SOURCES.items():
    binary = ROOT / variant / 'tauri-explorer'
    binary.parent.mkdir()
    shutil.copy2(source, binary)
    assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).digest() == hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).digest()
    BINARIES[variant] = binary
patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--binary', 'HEAD'], cwd='/tmp/tauri-explorer-listing-748')
(ROOT / 'candidate.patch').write_bytes(patch)
source_files = ['src/lib/api/directory-wire.ts', 'src/lib/api/files.ts', 'src-tauri/src/files/directory_wire.rs', 'src-tauri/src/files/mod.rs']
for name in source_files:
    target = ROOT / 'source-files' / name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(Path('/tmp/tauri-explorer-listing-748') / name, target)
ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0)  # adopt the release launcher’s forked child

def descendants():
    processes = {}
    for item in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not item.name.isdigit():
            continue
        try:
            fields = (item / 'stat').read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
            processes[int(item.name)] = (int(fields[1]), fields[19], fields[0])
        except (OSError, IndexError, ValueError):
            pass
    owned = {os.getpid()}
    while True:
        more = {pid for pid, (parent, _, _) in processes.items() if parent in owned}
        if more <= owned:
            break
        owned |= more
    return {(pid, processes[pid][1]): processes[pid][2] for pid in owned if pid != os.getpid()}

excluded = set()

def stop_app():
    started = time.monotonic()
    while time.monotonic() - started < 5:
        # As a subreaper, this supervisor retains ownership even when the app
        # dies before its WebKit children. PID/start-time pairs exclude display
        # processes; no scan or signal targets unrelated application instances.
        owned = descendants()
        remaining = {key: state for key, state in owned.items() if key not in excluded}
        for (pid, birth), state in remaining.items():
            if state != 'Z':
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM if time.monotonic() - started < 2 else signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
        try:
            while os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)[0]:
                pass
        except ChildProcessError:
            pass
        if not remaining:
            return
        time.sleep(.02)
    raise RuntimeError(f'benchmark children survived cleanup: {remaining}')

display_log = (ROOT / 'display.log').open('w')
xvfb = wm = None
samples = []
metadata = {
    'sourceCommit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd='/tmp/tauri-explorer-listing-748', text=True).strip(),
    'binarySha256': {variant: hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for variant, binary in BINARIES.items()},
    'candidatePatchSha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
    'baselineSourceCommit': 'b94ae493 (PR747); binary source and hash provenance in docs/reviews/arch-listing-737.json',
    'candidateDescription': 'compact listing IPC; sourceCommit is base, candidate.patch and source-files capture uncommitted production changes',
    'buildCommand': 'cargo build --release --locked --features tauri/custom-protocol --target-dir /home/chong/Repos/tauri-explorer/src-tauri/target',
    'buildCwd': '/tmp/tauri-explorer-listing-748/src-tauri',
    'profile': 'release, tauri/custom-protocol, no E2E hooks, default recovery features',
    'settings': {'warmWindow': False, 'viewMode': 'details'},
    'display': 'isolated Xvfb + Openbox, 1200x800, X11; not the interactive Wayland compositor',
    'cachePolicy': 'OS caches uncontrolled; 2 excluded warm-up launches per directory; fresh process, same isolated app profile per scenario',
    'endpoint': 'native receipt after settings, commands, initial listing and two animation-frame opportunities; not externally observed presented pixels or input',
    'kernel': os.uname().release,
    'cpu': next((line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('model name')), 'unknown'),
    'loadAtStart': os.getloadavg(),
}
try:
    read_fd, write_fd = os.pipe()
    try:
        xvfb = subprocess.Popen(['Xvfb', '-displayfd', str(write_fd), '-screen', '0', '1200x800x24', '-nolisten', 'tcp'], pass_fds=(write_fd,), stdout=display_log, stderr=display_log)
    finally:
        os.close(write_fd)
    with os.fdopen(read_fd) as pipe:
        if not select.select([pipe], [], [], 10)[0]:
            raise RuntimeError('Xvfb startup timed out')
        number = pipe.readline().strip()
        if not number.isdigit():
            raise RuntimeError('Xvfb failed to provide a display')
        display = ':' + number
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=display, GDK_BACKEND='x11', TAURI_EXPLORER_LOG_STDOUT='1')
    env.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY', None)
    env.pop('WARM_MEASURE', None)
    env.pop('LD_PRELOAD', None)
    wm = subprocess.Popen(['openbox'], env=env, stdout=display_log, stderr=display_log)
    time.sleep(.5)
    if xvfb.poll() is not None or wm.poll() is not None:
        raise RuntimeError('isolated display failed to start')
    excluded = set(descendants())
    for count in [100, 100000]:
        scenario = ROOT / f'entries-{count}'
        scenario.mkdir()
        files = Path('/tmp/startup-696-final-ab-mkbq04ib') / f'entries-{count}' / 'files'
        assert sum(1 for _ in files.iterdir()) == count
        appenv = dict(env)
        for kind in ['CONFIG', 'DATA', 'CACHE', 'STATE']:
            location = scenario / kind.lower()
            location.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            appenv[f'XDG_{kind}_HOME'] = str(location)
        config = scenario / 'config' / 'tauri-explorer'
        config.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (config / 'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'warmWindow': False, 'viewMode': 'details'}))
        for i in range(22):
            variants = ['baseline', 'compact'] if i % 2 == 0 else ['compact', 'baseline']
            for variant in variants:
                BINARY = BINARIES[variant]
                log = scenario / f'{variant}-{i:02d}.log'
                before_load = os.getloadavg()
                with log.open('w') as output:
                    started_epoch_ms = time.time_ns() / 1e6
                    started = time.monotonic()
                    launcher = subprocess.Popen([str(BINARY), str(files)], env=appenv, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                    try:
                        while time.monotonic() - started < 20:
                            text = log.read_text(errors='replace')
                            if all(mark in text for mark in ['Startup(native-ready): window=main', 'Startup(webview): window=main', 'Startup(native-window): window=main']):
                                break
                            time.sleep(.01)
                        else:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'readiness timed out: {log}')
                        if str(files) not in text:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'requested directory absent from log: {log}')
                        sample = {'variant': variant, 'entries': count, 'iteration': i, 'warmup': i < 2, 'log': str(log), 'launchEpochMs': started_epoch_ms, 'observedReceiptMs': (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 'load': before_load}
                        samples.append(sample)
                        print(json.dumps(sample), flush=True)
                    finally:
                        stop_app()
                        launcher.wait(timeout=5)
                (ROOT / 'samples.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metadata': metadata, 'samples': samples}, indent=2))
finally:
    try:
        stop_app()
    finally:
        for child in [wm, xvfb]:
            if child is None:
                continue
            child.terminate()
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                child.kill()
                child.wait()
        display_log.close()
